name: ai-coding-protocols
description: Manifest of agent skills: own skills (in skills/) plus third-party dependencies installed via the skills CLI (npx skills add). Third-party skills are declared, never committed.

own.note: Authored in this repository. Auto-discovered from skills/ — each directory with a SKILL.md. template/ is a scaffold (SKILL.template.md), not a skill. Install own skills with: npx skills add didacrios/ai-coding-protocols (GitHub, after this branch is pushed) or npx skills add <local-clone> while unpushed. recursive-exploration, typescript-standard, php-standard, code-review, refactor, documentation, skill-generator, and project-bootstrap landed in 2da73d6 (2026-02-26) when protocols/ became skills/. plan-initiative landed in 7552f1c (2026-04-10).

inspired_by.recursive-exploration: MIT CSAIL Recursive Language Models (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2512.24601) — idea, not a copied skill file

dependencies.note: MIT. Canonical origin of the engineering skills previously vendored via skillquarium (unlicensed mirror) and adapted by the opencode harness. Pinned to a tag for reproducibility; the skills CLI lockfile pins the resolved commit. Add more from the 25-skill catalog as needed: browser-testing-with-devtools (needs Chrome DevTools MCP), frontend-ui-engineering, git-workflow-and-versioning, observability-and-instrumentation, etc. Twelve of these are also shipped (adapted) by the OAK kit as its own skills; scripts/install-skills.mjs skips those when the kit is present so opencode never sees two skills with one name. Declared anyway: a harness without the kit needs them.
code-review exists in both repos; only one is installed (own emoji-driven variant lives in skills/code-review)

MIT. Previously vendored under skills/<name>/ (commit 2da73d6). Removed from this tree so the installer fetches upstream. Pin is upstream HEAD observed 2026-08-10. Local SKILL.md copies had no SPDX; declaring instead of vendoring closes the missing-NOTICE gap.

MIT. Previously vendored under skills/marketing/ (commit 43defc2) with older directory names and metadata.version 1.0–1.3. Removed from this tree so the installer fetches upstream 2.x names.
